acceptance_criteria.criterion: `AGENTS.md` contains documentation for `menu.sh` / `menu.cmd` describing how to launch the interactive developer menu.
`AGENTS.md` contains documentation for `composer setup` describing the interactive local environment setup.
The documentation style and formatting are consistent with the existing `AGENTS.md` content.

summary: All three acceptance criteria for WP-004 are already satisfied by the existing AGENTS.md content. Section 9 of AGENTS.md (lines 178–230) contains two subsections written during the WP-003 documentation pipeline that fully cover WP-004's scope: (1) '### Interactive Developer Menu' documents menu.sh / menu.cmd launch commands for Unix, Windows, and direct PHP invocation, the automatic vendor pre-flight, and a full dispatch table for all menu options; (2) '### Local Environment Setup' documents 'composer setup' describing the interactive prompts for DB and UI settings, config file generation from .dist.php templates, DB creation, schema import, seed-tests invocation, idempotency behaviour (existing values as defaults), and the direct php tools/setup-local.php invocation. Both subsections match the heading depth, code-block style, and table formatting of the surrounding AGENTS.md content. No edits to AGENTS.md were required.

comments.note: All three AC were already met by the '### Interactive Developer Menu' and '### Local Environment Setup' subsections added to AGENTS.md section 9 during the WP-003 documentation pipeline. No duplicate or missing content found. WP-004 documentation pass confirmed clean with no edits required.
